features.name: Expander picker replaces every dropdown
features.description: Brett, Nov 13 2026: "I don't want drop-down bars anymore. They are gonna be animated. It's gonna be a row with a name and a little arrow; when you press that arrow it expands a subgrid; you got to press it again to apply it and close it." New asset type expander-picker@1 (tiles, arrow, columns, density, animation, apply rule, preview; 8 starters) and the framework control ExpanderPicker: a row with the setting's name, current value and a little arrow unfolds in place (motion token, reduced motion respected) into a grid of option tiles that can show previews; one press highlights and previews, the same press again applies and closes. SelectField, every pick-one setting, Acting as and the window settings use it; check-dropdowns fails CI on any new raw <select>. API: every picker is a console-control setting:<label> target (state, set, press, open) reachable through REST, MCP console actions, axf control and voice.
